# FreshCut Home

> FreshCut Home is Karachi's premier online store for hygienically washed, pre-cut, and ready-to-cook fresh vegetables delivered daily across Karachi, Pakistan.

## Products & Catalog
- Pre-cut Vegetables: Chopped onions, peeled garlic, sliced bitter gourd, capsicum, julienne carrots, potato cubes, etc.
- Portion Sizes: Custom weights starting from 250g up to bulk orders (5kg+).
- Delivery: Free next-day delivery across Karachi for orders placed before 12 AM.
